definitions.explanation: The natural features of an area that can be seen, especially when considered in terms of their aesthetic appeal.

examples.japanese: {山|やま}の{風景|ふうけい}が{美|うつく}しい。
{窓|まど}から{見|み}える{風景|ふうけい}を{写真|しゃしん}に{撮|と}った。
examples.english: I took a photo of the scenery visible from the window.

examples.japanese: {風景画|ふうけいが}を{描|か}くのが{趣味|しゅみ}です。

notes:
USAGE: {風景|ふうけい} typically refers to natural scenery or landscapes, often with an aesthetic connotation.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{風景|ふうけい}を{眺|なが}める (to gaze at the scenery)
・{風景画|ふうけいが} (landscape painting)
・{風景|ふうけい}{写真|しゃしん} (landscape photography)
・{美|うつく}しい{風景|ふうけい} (beautiful scenery)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{景色|けしき} - scenery (more general, can include urban views)
・{眺|なが}め - view (what one sees from a particular spot)
・{光景|こうけい} - scene (often dramatic or memorable)
